text_en: He looked up and saw rich people putting their gifts into the treasury;
text_cn: 耶稣举目一望，看见富人把他们的献仪投入银库内。

text_en: he also saw a poor widow put in two small copper coins.
text_cn: 又看见一个贫苦的寡妇，把两文钱投入里面，

text_en: He said, “Truly I tell you, this poor widow has put in more than all of them;
text_cn: 遂说：“我实话告诉你们：这个穷寡妇比众人投入的都多，

text_en: for all of them have contributed out of their abundance, but she out of her poverty has put in all she had to live on. ”
text_cn: 因为众人都是拿他们多余的投入，作为给天主的献仪；而这个寡妇却是从她的不足中，把她所有的一切生活费都投上了。”

text_en: When some were speaking about the temple, how it was adorned with beautiful stones and gifts dedicated to God, he said,
text_cn: 有些人正谈论圣殿是用美丽的石头，和还愿的献品装饰的，耶稣说：

text_en: “As for these things that you see, the days will come when not one stone will be left upon another; all will be thrown down. ”
text_cn: “你们所看见的这一切，待那时日一到，没有一块石头留在另一块石头上，而不被拆毁的。”

text_en: They asked him, “Teacher, when will this be, and what will be the sign that this is about to take place? ”
text_cn: 他们遂问说：“师傅，那么，什么时候要发生这些事？这些事要发生的时候，将有什么先兆？”

text_en: And he said, “Beware that you are not led astray; for many will come in my name and say, ‘I am he! ’ and, ‘The time is near! ’ Do not go after them.
text_cn: 耶稣说：“你们要谨慎，不要受欺骗！因为将有许多人，假冒我的名字来说：我就是（默西亚）；又说：时期近了。你们切不可跟随他们。

text_en: “When you hear of wars and insurrections, do not be terrified; for these things must take place first, but the end will not follow immediately. ”
text_cn: 你们几时听见战争及叛乱，不要惊惶！因为这些事必须先要发生，但还不即刻是结局。”

text_en: Then he said to them, “Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom;
text_cn: 耶稣遂又给他们说：“民族要起来攻击民族，国家攻击国家；

text_en: there will be great earthquakes, and in various places famines and plagues; and there will be dreadful portents and great signs from heaven.
text_cn: 将有大地震，到处有饥荒及瘟疫；将出现可怖的异象，天上要有巨大的凶兆。

text_en: “But before all this occurs, they will arrest you and persecute you; they will hand you over to synagogues and prisons, and you will be brought before kings and governors because of my name.
text_cn: 但是，这一切事以前，为了我名字的原故，人们要下手把你们拘捕、迫害、解送到会堂，并囚于狱中；且押送到君王及总督之前，

text_en: This will give you an opportunity to testify.
text_cn: 为给你们一个作见证的机会。

text_en: So make up your minds not to prepare your defense in advance;
text_cn: 所以，你们心中要镇定，不要事先考虑申辩，

text_en: for I will give you words and a wisdom that none of your opponents will be able to withstand or contradict.
text_cn: 因为我要给你们口才和明智，是你们的一切仇敌所不能抵抗及辩驳的。

text_en: You will be betrayed even by parents and brothers, by relatives and friends; and they will put some of you to death.
text_cn: 你们要为父母、兄弟、亲戚及朋友所出卖；你们中有一些要被杀死。

text_en: You will be hated by all because of my name.
text_cn: 你们要为了我的名字，受众人的憎恨；

text_en: But not a hair of your head will perish.
text_cn: 但是，连你们的一根头发，也不会失落。

text_en: By your endurance you will gain your souls.
text_cn: 你们要凭着坚忍，保全你们的灵魂。”

text_en: “When you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that its desolation has come near.
text_cn: “几时你们看见耶路撒冷被军队围困，那时你们便知道：她的荒凉近了。

text_en: Then those in Judea must flee to the mountains, and those inside the city must leave it, and those out in the country must not enter it;
text_cn: 那时，在犹太的，要逃往山中；在京都中的，要离去；在乡间的，不要进京。

text_en: for these are days of vengeance, as a fulfillment of all that is written.
text_cn: 因为这是报复的日子，为要应验所记载的一切。

text_en: Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who are nursing infants in those days! For there will be great distress on the earth and wrath against this people;
text_cn: 在那些日子内，怀孕的及哺乳的，是有祸的，因为要有大难降临这地方，要有义怒临于这百姓身上。

text_en: they will fall by the edge of the sword and be taken away as captives among all nations; and Jerusalem will be trampled on by the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.
text_cn: 他们要倒在剑刃之下，要被掳往列国；耶路撒冷要受异民蹂躏，直到异民的时期满限。”

text_en: “There will be signs in the sun, the moon, and the stars, and on the earth distress among nations confused by the roaring of the sea and the waves.
text_cn: “在日月星辰上，将有异兆出现；在地上，万国要因海洋波涛的怒号而惊惶失措。

text_en: People will faint from fear and foreboding of what is coming upon the world, for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.
text_cn: 众人要因恐惧，等待即将临于天下的事而昏绝，因为诸天的万象将要动摇。

text_en: Then they will see ‘the Son of Man coming in a cloud’ with power and great glory.
text_cn: 那时，他们要看见人子，带着威能及莫大光荣乘云降来。

text_en: Now when these things begin to take place, stand up and raise your heads, because your redemption is drawing near. ”
text_cn: 这些事开始发生时，你们应当挺起身来，抬起你们的头，因为你们的救援近了。”

text_en: Then he told them a parable: “Look at the fig tree and all the trees;
text_cn: 耶稣又给他们设了一个比喻：“你们看看无花果树及各种树木，

text_en: as soon as they sprout leaves you can see for yourselves and know that summer is already near.
text_cn: 几时，你们看见它们已经发芽，就知道：夏天已经近了。

text_en: So also, when you see these things taking place, you know that the kingdom of God is near.
text_cn: 同样，几时你们看见这些事发生了，也应知道：天主的国近了。

text_en: Truly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all things have taken place.
text_cn: 我实在告诉你们：非等一切事发生了，这一代决不会过去。

text_en: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
text_cn: 天地要过去，但是，我的话决不会过去。

text_en: “Be on guard so that your hearts are not weighed down with dissipation and drunkenness and the worries of this life, and that day does not catch you unexpectedly,
text_cn: 你们应当谨慎，免得你们的心为宴饮沉醉，及人生的挂虑所累时，那意想不到的日子临于你们，

text_en: like a trap. For it will come upon all who live on the face of the whole earth.
text_cn: 因为那日子有如罗网，临于全地面的一切居民。

text_en: Be alert at all times, praying that you may have the strength to escape all these things that will take place, and to stand before the Son of Man. ”
text_cn: 所以，你们应当时时醒寤祈祷，为使你们能逃脱即将发生的这一切事，并能立于人子之前。”

text_en: Every day he was teaching in the temple, and at night he would go out and spend the night on the Mount of Olives, as it was called.
text_cn: 耶稣白天在圣殿施教，黑夜便出去，到名叫橄榄的山上住宿。

text_en: And all the people would get up early in the morning to listen to him in the temple.
text_cn: 众百姓清早起来，到他跟前，在圣殿里听他讲道。
